works.author: Nixtio
works.comment: 保健品电商产品页 Jevi：中央一瓶橙色 Metabolic Balance 胶囊配黄色 -50% 标签，左栏 4.9 分（258 条评价）加成分表（Oleoylethanolamide 150mg、Alpha-GPC 200mg），右栏功效与规格选择器（Metabolic Balance / Cortisol Help、15 / 50 粒）、数量 2、$129.98 对 $259.96；保健品详情页用“成分透明 + 规格自选 + 划线价”一次打消购买疑虑。
works.comment_en: Jevi supplement product page: an orange Metabolic Balance bottle with a yellow -50% tag, a 4.9 rating (258 reviews) and a full ingredient table (Oleoylethanolamide 150 mg, Alpha-GPC 200 mg) on the left, benefit and size pickers (Metabolic Balance / Cortisol Help, 15 / 50 capsules), quantity 2 and $129.98 struck against $259.96 on the right — transparent ingredients, self-serve options and a struck-through price that remove every buying doubt in one screen.
works.title: Supplement E-commerce Website – Product Page Design

works.author: Jack R. for RonDesignLab
works.comment: 智能健康追踪 App SuperPower：顶部一条绿橙渐变刻度条，大标题“Top Supplements for You”，下方两张产品卡各贴一枚荧光绿 Best Seller 标签；健康 App 用“渐变仪表感 + 高亮标签”把个性化推荐做得一眼可信。
works.comment_en: SuperPower smart health tracking app: a green-to-orange gradient gauge crowns the screen above the headline "Top Supplements for You", with two product cards each carrying a lime Best Seller tag — gradient meter plus highlight labels make personalized supplement picks feel instantly credible.
works.title: SuperPower Mobile – Smart Health Tracking App UI

works.author: Permadi Satria Dewanto for Plainthing Studio
works.comment: AI 运营层官网 FIELD：显示器实拍里大标题“Your work, understood.”，品红 Get Started 按钮配黑白像素块点缀，黑底衬出白屏；AI SaaS 落地页用“一句人话口号 + 实机截图 + 一抹品牌色”讲清抽象产品。
works.comment_en: FIELD AI operating layer site: a monitor mockup carries the headline "Your work, understood." with a magenta Get Started button and black-and-white pixel accents on a dark backdrop — one plain-language slogan, a real product screenshot and a single brand color make an abstract AI product concrete.
works.title: FIELD - AI-Powered Operating Layer Website Animation

works.author: Bayu Aji Sadewa for Korsa
works.comment: 智能戒指电商落地页 Solace：灰调笔记本实拍屏上银色戒指大图居中，大标题“solace smart ring”，左下 Sleep Tracking 卡片、底部 Heart & Recovery / Activity & Fitness / Women's Health 四枚功能入口；可穿戴电商用“实拍硬件 + 场景化功能入口”一次讲清卖点。
works.comment_en: Solace smart ring store: a laptop mockup in grey tones centers a large silver ring render under the headline "solace smart ring", with a Sleep Tracking card and four feature chips — Heart & Recovery, Activity & Fitness, Women's Health — below; real hardware photography plus scenario-based entry points sell the wearable in one view.
works.title: Solace - Smart Ring E-Commerce Landing Page Animation

works.author: Outcrowd
works.comment: 支付平台落地页 Payway：大标题“Payments that feel effortless”，effortless 一词橙色加粗，PayPal / G Pay / Link / VISA / Discover 五张卡片叠在手机上，绿色开关、闪电与挂锁图标点缀；支付产品用“卡片墙 + 安全符号”把无感支付的承诺做实。
works.comment_en: Payway payment platform landing page: the headline "Payments that feel effortless" with effortless in bold orange, five cards (PayPal, G Pay, Link, VISA, Discover) fanned over a phone, a green toggle and lightning and padlock icons — a wall of cards plus security symbols makes the effortless-payments promise feel real.
works.title: Payment Platform Landing Page

works.author: Purrweb UI/UX Agency
works.comment: 加密税务软件：粉底上左侧大字“ONE YEAR. 900 TRADES.”，右侧深紫账本界面贴出 K 线图与成交量柱，底部应税基数 $4,214,306；枯燥的税务数据用“大字报 + 交易终端”讲成一个有故事的年度复盘。
works.comment_en: Crypto tax software: a pink backdrop with the poster-style headline "ONE YEAR. 900 TRADES." on the left and a deep-purple ledger with candlestick and volume charts on the right, closing on a $4,214,306 taxable base — dry tax data retold as a year-in-review story through big type and a trading-terminal aesthetic.
works.title: Crypto Tax Software Web App Design

works.author: Ronas IT | UI/UX Team
works.comment: 金融科技 App 双屏：左屏余额 $25,986.29、Mastercard 卡片、返现与储蓄（+8.4%、$1,315.80）卡片加最近交易，右屏收支曲线（收入 $4,734.00、支出 $2,068.51）与交易列表；黑底配绿线，金融 App 用“大余额 + 收支对比”一次给足掌控感。
works.comment_en: Fintech mobile app on two phones: the left screen shows a $25,986.29 balance, a Mastercard, cashback and savings cards (+8.4%, $1,315.80) and recent transactions; the right shows an income-versus-expenses curve ($4,734.00 in, $2,068.51 out) and a transaction list — a black layout with a green chart line that puts total control in one glance.
works.title: Finance Dashboard - Fintech Mobile App

works.author: Imran Hossen
works.comment: AI 时尚电商 NexFit：大标题“SMART SHOP BETTER FITS”，模特试戴白帽，右上 Style Match 96% 卡片、单品 Try this 按钮，底部 AI 推荐 Oversized Tee & Classic Cap（$86）；AI 穿搭电商用“匹配度数字 + 虚拟试穿入口”把算法变成可感知的购物体验。
works.comment_en: NexFit AI fashion store: the headline "SMART SHOP BETTER FITS" over a model trying on a white cap, a Style Match 96% card, Try this buttons on each garment and an AI-recommended Oversized Tee & Classic Cap ($86) below — a match score plus virtual try-on turns the algorithm into a shopping experience you can feel.
works.title: AI Fashion E-commerce Website | AI Stylist & Virtual Try-On
